proof_body:
by
  intro f K h
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hK : 0 < |K| + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨ε / (|K| + 1), div_pos hε hK, fun {x y} hxy => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at hxy ⊢
  calc |f x - f y| ≤ K * |x - y| := h x y
    _ ≤ (|K| + 1) * |x - y| := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
        linarith [le_abs_self K]
    _ < (|K| + 1) * (ε / (|K| + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hxy hK
    _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε hK.ne'
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), (∀ x y : ℝ, |f x - f y| ≤ K * |x - y|) → UniformContinuous f
